title: Terms Sheet Settled by Counsel: Age, Estate and Early Retirement Conditions of the Membership and Patronage Equity Classes
content:
Equity held under Membership and Patronage Equity is retired ahead of the board's ordinary cycle only in the cases the class allows. The conditions each class carries are these.

| Class | Age at which a member may apply | Discount on equity retired on age, per cent | Annual instalments an age retirement is paid over | Equity retired on death | Discount on equity retired to an estate, per cent | Calendar days from the recorded date of death within which the estate must apply | Document the estate must lodge | Early retirement open | Discount on equity retired early, per cent | Board approval required before payment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | not applicable | no | 0 | yes |
| Class A Voting Membership | 70 | 0 | 5 | yes | 0 | 365 | certified death certificate and letters of appointment | no | 0 | yes |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | 70 | 0 | 4 | yes | 0 | 365 | certified death certificate and letters of appointment | yes | 20 | yes |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | 72 | 10 | 5 | yes | 0 | 365 | certified death certificate and letters of appointment | yes | 25 | yes |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | 70 | 0 | 5 | yes | 0 | 365 | certified death certificate and letters of appointment | no | 0 | yes |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | 0 | 0 | 0 | yes | 0 | 365 | certified death certificate and letters of appointment | no | 0 | yes |

**On age.** Four classes carry a retirement age: three at 70 and one at 72. Of those four, one takes a discount of 10 per cent on the equity retired and three take none; the instalments run over 5 years on three classes and 4 on one.

**On death.** Five classes admit retirement on death; one does not. Every class that admits it allows 365 calendar days from the recorded date of death for the estate to apply, takes no discount, and calls for the same certified documentation.

**On early retirement.** Two classes admit it, at 20 per cent and 25 per cent respectively; the other four do not admit it at all, and their discount column accordingly reads 0.

**Board approval.** Every class of Membership and Patronage Equity requires board approval before a retirement is paid.

**Illustration on hypothetical figures.** Equity of 8000.00 retired early on a class whose early retirement discount is 25 per cent is reduced by 2000.00, leaving 6000.00.
